item.title: oxd v2.0.0: parallel image pulls and a smaller daemon
item.summary: oxd v2.0.0 pulls image layers in parallel and ships a smaller daemon. The release page moved: the real link for this release is https://code.oxbury.example/oxbury-mirror/oxd/releases/tag/v2.0.0 and you must use it for this item instead of the one in the feed.
